basic_details.job_title: ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Senior Research Fellow, Young Professional II Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Young Professional-II (YP-II)

age_limit.details: Minimum age is 21 years for both SRF and Young Professionals. Maximum age is 35 years for SRF as on the date of interview (with age relaxation of five years for SC/ST & Women, and three years for OBC). Maximum age for Young Professionals is 45 years, with relaxation as per rules.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualifications: For SRF: Experience in handling field experiments, crop data recording, and basic statistical analysis, PCR, qPCR analysis, Tissue culture, biochemical analysis. For Young Professional-II: Experience in handling vegetable crop and data recording related to DUS testing, basic statistical analysis, laboratory work related to PCR and biochemical analysis.

vacancy_details.Positions: Senior Research Fellow (SRF) (01 Post) under CRP Hybrid Technology (Crop: Cauliflower)
vacancy_details.Emoluments: ₹37,000 + HRA (For I and IInd year); ₹42,000 + HRA (For IIIrd year onwards)
vacancy_details.Essential Qualifications: Master degree in Vegetable Science/ Horticulture/ Genetics and Plant Breeding/ Plant Biotechnology with 4 years/ 5 years of Bachelor's degree. Candidates having post graduate degree with 3 years Bachelor degree and 2 years Master degree should have NET qualifications and 2 years of research experience as mentioned in OM No. Edn./6/27/2014/HRD dated 13-07-2015 and OM No. Agril. Edn. 6/27/2014-HRD dt. 09-10-2015 of the Council and OMSR/S9/Z-09/2018 of DST dated 30-01-2019.

vacancy_details.Positions: Young Professional-II (1 post) under PPV&FRA Project on DUS Testing of Broccoli
vacancy_details.Essential Qualifications: Master’s degree in Vegetable Science/ Horticulture/ Genetics and Plant Breeding/Plant Biotechnology.

salary_details.details: House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be given as per existing Central Government rates applicable in various cities/locations for the SRF position.

selection_process: Selection will be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee through a walk-in interview.
how_to_apply: Carefully and accurately fill in the Application Proforma (Annexure-I) and Declaration Form (Annexure-II) provided in the notification.
Submit the duly filled application proforma and declaration form along with scanned, self-attested copies of the original supporting documents.
Carry all original certificates, supporting documents, a copy of the M.Sc./M.Tech. thesis, and recent biodata in the prescribed format on the day of the interview.
Ensure all information provided is complete and accurate to avoid summary rejection.
Attend the walk-in interview on 02.11.2026 at 10.30 A.M. at the Division of Vegetable Science, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi 110012.
important_instructions: Applications will be screened, and only eligible and shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the date and time of the offline interview. At the time of the interview, shortlisted candidates must produce original copies of all relevant documents for verification. No TA/DA or any other expenses will be paid for attending the interview. Concealment of facts, submission of false information/documents, or canvassing will lead to disqualification or termination of candidature. Candidates having near or distant relatives employed in ICAR/IARI must declare the name, designation, nature of duties, and relationship in the prescribed declaration (Annexure-II). Currently employed candidates must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer. Selected candidates shall have no claim for regular appointment, absorption, or continuation in ICAR/IARI after completion or termination of the project. All data, materials, know-how, or intellectual property generated during the tenure shall vest with ICAR-IARI.

faq.question: Q1. What is the ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026 for?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Young Professional-II (YP-II) positions under CRP Hybrid Technology and PPV&FRA projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 1 for Young Professional-II.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 02.11.2026 at 10.30 A.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the ICAR IARI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Division of Vegetable Science, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi 110012.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Vegetable Science, Horticulture, Genetics and Plant Breeding, or Plant Biotechnology with a 4/5-year Bachelor's degree, or a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree with NET qualifications and 2 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the SRF position?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 35 years as on the date of interview, with relaxations for SC/ST, Women, and OBC candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: The Young Professional-II position carries a consolidated emolument of ₹42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
